description: Get water-stress risk for a US lat/lon or state, for cooling-water planning.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90) for the most precise water-risk read, e.g. 33.45

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

location.description: Market NAME or metro slug instead of coordinates, e.g. "phoenix", "northern-virginia", "dallas". Resolved to that market's PUBLISHED CENTROID through the DCPI market row, and the answer carries a resolved_from block saying so. A MARKET-level read, not your parcel; pass lat/lon for a specific site. Not an alias for lat/lon: a place name is not a coordinate.

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180), e.g. -112.07

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

state.description: US state abbreviation as an alternative to lat/lon, e.g. AZ

name: get_water_risk
title: Water Risk
